note: M98 P2000 Q50 starts the called program O2000 at its N50, so the Q names a block of that program and not of the caller. The rule that fires on a M98 block carrying a P is rewrite: false (I6, plan §0 item 5), so the value is reported and never touched — not merely left alone because this caller happens to have no N50 of its own. A main program that did have one would otherwise have had its call moved to the wrong place in silence.
